facts.text: Found in the attic. Reads like a tax form.
facts.why: Adam says the Handbook for the Recently Deceased reads like stereo instructions. Nothing I opened mentions taxes. Otho does find the handbook in the attic with the model, so the first half holds.
facts.fix: Found in the attic. Reads like stereo instructions.

facts.why: Printed in the late night Bio-Exorcist ad. The ad I read opens with 'I'll do anything. I'll scare 'em real bad.' and calls him the afterlife's leading bio-exorcist. I could not find the printed line in it.

facts.text: No phone. Just say the name.
facts.why: The ad shows the name BETELGEUSE onscreen three times, which fits 'say the name'. I could not confirm whether the ad also shows a phone number.
facts.fix: Just say the name. Three times.

vibe.verdict: The Deetz dinner party, Netherworld ticket and model town all look right, and the shrimp cocktail grabbing back is the best joke on the page.
